in_sanskrit.name: दर्मेन्द्र
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Darmendra is derived from the Sanskrit words 'dharma' meaning righteousness, and 'indra' meaning lord or god. Thus, Darmendra can be interpreted as 'the lord or god of righteousness'.

in_marathi.name: Darmendra
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Righteousness
in_marathi.long_meaning: Darmendra हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Darmendra is a name derived from the Sanskrit words 'dharma' meaning 'righteousness' and 'indra' meaning 'god'. In Hindu mythology, Darmendra is considered the god of righteousness, morality, and justice. He is also known as Yama, the god of death. The name signifies a strong sense of duty and a commitment to upholding righteousness and justice.
